info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Meetings Meetings Notes-v3-spec
info.description: The Meeting Notes Retrieval API enables users to fetch detailed notes associated with scheduled meetings. This API provides access to essential information and insights that can enhance meeting preparations and follow-ups. Typical consumers include meeting coordinators, project managers, and team members who need to review or reference meeting discussions. By leveraging this API, clients can efficiently retrieve relevant notes and improve collaboration across teams.

get.description: Fetches all the notes associated with meetings. This API provides a convenient way for users to access and manage meeting notes effectively.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving meeting notes. Ensure to provide necessary parameters in the schema to fetch the specific notes you require.
